TABLE.NAME: local_credentiumclaim_status
TABLE.COMMENT: Tracks the claim status of issued Credentium credentials per user.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Moodle user the credential belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: credentialkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Credentium issueRequestId used for status and claim-link calls.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the credential was issued for (nullable).

FIELD.NAME: credentialid
FIELD.COMMENT: Credentium credentialId, reported once issuance produces a credential. Distinct from credentialkey (the issueRequestId) and needed to link a claimed credential to its page in the wallet.

FIELD.NAME: remotestatus
FIELD.COMMENT: Last known Credentium status: processing, issued, claimed, failed, unknown.

FIELD.NAME: dismissed
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the user dismissed or acted on the banner for this credential.

FIELD.NAME: timechecked
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of the last remote status poll.

KEY.NAME: useridcredentialkey
KEY.COMMENT: One tracking row per user per credential; also indexes userid.
